how_to_read: Every fact object has "value", "source" (exact URL), "quote" (verbatim snippet of the saved page text, whitespace collapsed) and "verified".
"verified": false means no official statement was found; "value" is then null and "note" says where I looked. Nothing was filled in from memory or third-party sites.
"also" lists further official quotes supporting (or restating) the same fact. "basis" marks values observed from Ingram's public calculators rather than read in a document.
Print dimensions are inches; "value_mm" is given only where the source prints millimetres (as printed by Ingram, including its rounding).
Saved text of every source is under pages/ (first line = URL). Quotes were machine-checked against those files when this JSON was built.

Calculator values are thicker than pages / published PPI (e.g. 200 pages 50lb white: 200/512 = 0.391 in vs 0.424 in from the calculator). Use the calculator or the template, not the PPI sheet, for the cover.

Hardcover (case laminate, jacketed, cloth) spine widths come back in 1/16 in steps with a minimum of 0.25 in, and are identical for case laminate, jacketed case laminate and Digital Cloth of the same paper and page count.
